name: widget-card
title: Widget Card
description: The card a chart, list or metric sits in: a title row with room for a trailing action, and a content area that can scroll inside a fixed height. Uses namespace exports: WidgetCard.Root, WidgetCard.Header, WidgetCard.Title, WidgetCard.Content.

docs.lead: The surface for a single chart, list or metric. Set the card's height on Root; the content area fills what the header leaves and can scroll inside it rather than overflowing the card.
docs.usage:
import * as WidgetCard from "@/components/ui/widget-card"

<WidgetCard.Root className="h-[288px]">
  <WidgetCard.Header>
    <WidgetCard.Title>Card title</WidgetCard.Title>
  </WidgetCard.Header>
  <WidgetCard.Content>{chart}</WidgetCard.Content>
</WidgetCard.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A title and whatever the card holds. The card's height comes from className on Root.

examples.title: With details
examples.description: Anything placed after the title sits at the end of the header row. Use a neutral stroke xxsmall Button for the Details action.
examples.code:
<WidgetCard.Header>
  <WidgetCard.Title>Card title</WidgetCard.Title>
  <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke" size="xxsmall" onClick={openDetails}>
    Details
  </Button.Root>
</WidgetCard.Header>

examples.title: Compact title
examples.description: KPI cards use a smaller, muted title and a tighter gap. Both are className overrides.

api.name: WidgetCard.Root
api.description: The card surface. Set its height with className; it has none by default.

props.name: className
props.description: Height, width and any other overrides

api.name: WidgetCard.Header
api.description: The title row. The first child sits at the start, anything after it at the end.

api.name: WidgetCard.Title
api.description: The card title, rendered as an h3.

api.name: WidgetCard.Content
api.description: Fills the space below the header and can shrink below its content, so a fixed-height card constrains it.

props.name: className
props.description: Add overflow-y-auto when the content can outgrow the card
